title: Physics-informed machine learning: a hybrid lens for fluid dynamics
title_zh: 物理信息机器学习：流体动力学的混合透镜
abstract: A neural network approach bridging Lagrangian and Eulerian perspectives transforms sparse observations into physically accurate, high-resolution maps of complex and chaotic fluid motions.
abstract_zh: 一种神经网络方法，桥接拉格朗日和欧拉视角，将稀疏观测转化为复杂混沌流体运动的物理准确的高分辨率映射。
